expect.title: Things Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Must be paid by customers, e.g. resort island excursion trip.

expect.title: Airport Transfer & Island Activities by Speedboat
expect.body: Speedboat is on a sharing basis.

expect.title: Prepare Cash
expect.body: Prepare cash if you plan to shop at Maafushi Island. Cards and QR are not available at some shops and street stalls.

expect.title: Wet Season
expect.body: May to September. Prepare attire and shoes that are suitable to wear during the rainy season.

expect.title: Arrival at Male Airport
expect.body: Hotel or resort staff will be available at the airport upon arrival. Extra charges apply for arrivals after 8pm.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Late booking surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if the booking is made less than 45 days before departure.
Itinerary, price and flight are subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements 14 days before the trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity before booking any connecting domestic flights.
Itinerary during the trip is subject to changes (due to weather, traffic, safety, etc.).
Any free activity is non-exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash if the client does not join, or due to availability and weather conditions.
